name: Self-Enshrouded Recluse
set_bonus_2pc: The provided Shield Effect increases by 10%.
set_bonus_4pc: Increases the Shield Effect provided by the wearer by 12%. When an ally target holds a Shield provided by the wearer, the ally target's CRIT DMG increases by 15%.

name: World-Remaking Deliverer
set_bonus_4pc: After the wearer uses Basic ATK or Skill, if the wearer's memosprite is on the field, increases Max HP of the wearer and their memosprite by 24%, and increases all allies' dealt DMG by 15%, lasting until after the wearer's next use of Basic ATK or Skill.

name: Wavestrider Captain
set_bonus_4pc: When the wearer becomes the target of another ally target's ability, gains 1 stack of "Help," stacking up to 2 time(s). If there are 2 stack(s) of "Help" when the wearer uses their Ultimate, consumes all "Help" to increase the wearer's ATK by 48% for 1 turn(s).

name: Warrior Goddess of Sun and Thunder
set_bonus_4pc: When the wearer or their memosprite provides healing to ally targets other than themselves, the wearer gains "Gentle Rain," which lasts for 2 turn(s) and can only trigger once per turn. While the wearer has "Gentle Rain," SPD increases by 6% and all allies' CRIT DMG increases by 15%. This effect cannot stack.

name: Poet of Mourning Collapse
set_bonus_4pc: Decreases the wearer's SPD by 8%. Before entering battle, if the wearer's SPD is lower than 110/95, increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by 20%/32%. This effect applies to the wearer's memosprite at the same time.

name: Hero of Triumphant Song
set_bonus_4pc: While the wearer's memosprite is on the field, increases the wearer's SPD by 6%. When the wearer's memosprite attacks, increases the wearer's and memosprite's CRIT DMG by 30%, lasting for 2 turn(s).

name: Scholar Lost in Erudition
set_bonus_4pc: Increases DMG dealt by Skill and Ultimate by 20%. After using Ultimate, additionally increases the DMG dealt by the next Skill by 25%.

name: Sacerdos' Relived Ordeal
set_bonus_4pc: When using Skill or Ultimate on one ally target, increases the ability target's CRIT DMG by 18%, lasting for 2 turn(s). This effect can stack up to 2 time(s).

name: The Wind-Soaring Valorous
set_bonus_4pc: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by 6%. After the wearer uses a Follow-Up ATK, increases DMG dealt by Ultimate by 36%, lasting for 1 turn(s).

name: Iron Cavalry Against the Scourge
set_bonus_4pc: If the wearer's Break Effect is 150% or higher, the Break DMG dealt to the enemy target ignores 10% of their DEF. If the wearer's Break Effect is 250% or higher, the Super Break DMG dealt to the enemy target additionally ignores 15% of their DEF.

name: Watchmaker, Master of Dream Machinations
set_bonus_4pc: When the wearer uses their Ultimate on an ally, all allies' Break Effect increases by 30% for 2 turn(s). This effect cannot be stacked.

name: Pioneer Diver of Dead Waters
set_bonus_2pc: Increases DMG dealt to enemies with debuffs by 12%.
set_bonus_4pc: Increases CRIT Rate by 4%. The wearer deals 8%/12% increased CRIT DMG to enemies with at least 2/3 debuffs. After the wearer inflicts a debuff on enemy targets, the aforementioned effects increase by 100%, lasting for 1 turn(s).

name: Prisoner in Deep Confinement
set_bonus_4pc: For every DoT the enemy target is afflicted with, the wearer will ignore 6% of its DEF when dealing DMG to it. This effect is valid for a max of 3 DoTs.

name: The Ashblazing Grand Duke
set_bonus_2pc: Increases the DMG dealt by Follow-Up ATK by 20%.
set_bonus_4pc: When the wearer uses a Follow-Up ATK, increases the wearer's ATK by 6% for every time the Follow-Up ATK deals DMG. This effect can stack up to 8 time(s) and lasts for 3 turn(s). This effect is removed the next time the wearer uses a Follow-Up ATK.

name: Messenger Traversing Hackerspace
set_bonus_4pc: When the wearer uses their Ultimate on an ally, SPD for all allies increases by 12% for 1 turn(s). This effect cannot be stacked.

name: Longevous Disciple
set_bonus_4pc: When the wearer is hit or has their HP consumed by an ally or themselves, their CRIT Rate increases by 8% for 2 turn(s) and up to 2 stacks.

name: Wastelander of Banditry Desert
set_bonus_4pc: When dealing DMG to debuffed enemy targets, the wearer has their CRIT Rate increased by 10%. And when they deal DMG to Imprisoned enemy targets, their CRIT DMG increases by 20%.

name: Thief of Shooting Meteor
set_bonus_4pc: Increases the wearer's Break Effect by 16%. After the wearer inflicts Weakness Break on an enemy, regenerates 3 Energy.

name: Eagle of Twilight Line
set_bonus_4pc: After the wearer uses their Ultimate, their action is Advanced Forward by 25%.

name: Band of Sizzling Thunder
set_bonus_4pc: When the wearer uses their Skill, increases the wearer's ATK by 20% for 1 turn(s).

name: Genius of Brilliant Stars
set_bonus_4pc: When the wearer deals DMG to the target enemy, ignores 10% DEF. If the target enemy has Quantum Weakness, the wearer additionally ignores 10% DEF.

name: Firesmith of Lava-Forging
set_bonus_4pc: Increases DMG by the wearer's Skill by 12%. After unleashing Ultimate, increases the wearer's Fire DMG by 12% for the next attack.

name: Guard of Wuthering Snow
set_bonus_4pc: At the beginning of the turn, if the wearer's HP percentage is equal to or less than 50%, restores HP equal to 8% of their Max HP and regenerates 5 Energy.

name: Champion of Streetwise Boxing
set_bonus_4pc: After the wearer attacks or is hit, their ATK increases by 5% for the rest of the battle. This effect can stack up to 5 time(s).

name: Hunter of Glacial Forest
set_bonus_4pc: After the wearer uses their Ultimate, their CRIT DMG increases by 25% for 2 turn(s).

name: Knight of Purity Palace
set_bonus_4pc: Increases the max DMG that can be absorbed by the Shield created by the wearer by 20%.

name: Musketeer of Wild Wheat
set_bonus_4pc: The wearer's SPD increases by 6% and DMG dealt by Basic ATK increases by 10%.

name: Passerby of Wandering Cloud
set_bonus_4pc: At the start of the battle, immediately regenerates 1 Skill Point.
